title: Account Executive - Portfolio
locations: North Sydney, New South Wales, Australia
teaser: Seeking an Account Executive to drive Cisco’s Service Provider Networking and Automation portfolio in Australia. Lead strategic growth, build key stakeholder relationships, and expand Cisco’s footprint. Ideal for candidates with strong account management or business development experience in the Service Provider/Telecommunications sector.
description:
Account Executive – Australia Service Provider

Meet the Team

As an Account Executive, you will be a key member of the Australia Service Provider Sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving and expanding Cisco’s footprint within an Account. You will serve as the primary business development and sales lead for Cisco’s Service Provider Networking and Automation portfolio. This role acts as a strategic driver, aligning Cisco’s cutting-edge technology, to Service Providers Transformation Goals.

Your Impact

Strategic Growth: Develop and implement comprehensive account strategies to meet and exceed sales targets specifically for the identified Cisco portfolio.

Relationship Excellence: Build, maintain, and deepen relationships with key stakeholders, decision-makers, and business influencers within the Account.

Market Expansion: Identify, qualify, and pursue new "white-space" business opportunities to expand Cisco’s footprint in Networking and Automation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with the Account Lead and internal teams including technical specialists, finance, legal, and product teams to propose tailored solutions.

Value Articulation: Effectively present Cisco’s solutions, clearly articulating the value propositions of Networking and Automation in a Service Provider environment.

Thought Leadership: Conduct formal presentations, and workshops to educate and influence stakeholders on Cisco’s innovation roadmap.

Commercial Navigation: Navigate complex Service Provider procurement and commercial frameworks to ensure successful deal closure and contract execution.

Operational Excellence: Provide accurate and timely sales forecasts, pipeline reports, and account status updates to Cisco leadership.

Brand Advocacy: Represent Cisco at events, industry forums, and technology days to enhance brand visibility and thought leadership.

Customer Success: Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction by proactively addressing business challenges and facilitating solutioning to deliver outcomes.

 

 

Minimum Qualifications

Consistent record in account management or business development within the Service Provider/Telecommunications sector.

Strong knowledge of sales cycles, including experience with complex deals.

Exceptional communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present complex solutions persuasively to diverse audiences.

Proven ability to handle multiple opportunities concurrently with high attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Deep understanding of Service Provider specific Networking and Automation requirements and technology trends.

High level of familiarity with Cisco’s product portfolio is strongly preferred.

Skilled in delivering engaging, outcome-based presentations tailored to Service Provider business needs.

A customer-centric approach with a proven ability to build trust and deliver long-term value.

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
